mentions.name: Hachi
mentions.description: A programming language designed for easy C/C++ interop and general-purpose scripting, used to build tools and replace bash and Python scripts. It is actively developed with regular updates to the compiler and core library modules and is currently at version 0.5.
mentions.problem: The author wanted to modernize C/C++ code with easy interop and couldn't find an existing language that fit, so they built their own.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on the Hachi programming language (https://hdev.run).
